label: VERIFIED
extraction: MCP Transports: JSON-RPC 2.0 over UTF-8. Two standard transports: 1) stdio - communication over stdin/stdout for local development/IDE environments. 2) Streamable HTTP - for remote async operations. WebSocket (β) for live streaming/push updates. Each transport must support capability negotiation: version, client_id, server_id, transport type (stdio|http|ws), capabilities (async, registry, code_exec). STDIO transport SHOULD NOT follow HTTP auth spec, instead retrieve credentials from environment. HTTP transport SHOULD conform to OAuth 2.1 auth spec.
